0:6:
Once upon a time, so very long ago in a faraway land, there was a witch 
who ruled a kingdom surrounded by a forest. The witch performed powerful 
magic to grant people's wishes, and the people adored her as a god.
However, granting those wishes came at the cost of the requester's life.
Still, people sought after the witch's magical power for miracles,
and the number of people who sought this power never decreased.
1:6:
One time, a desperate mother came to the witch.“Please cure my 
daughter's fatal, incurable disease... I will give my life in return.”
The witch granted the mother's wish, but the witch did not immediately 
take her life and allowed her to return home. The mother embraced her 
daughter, who was cured from her illness, and shed many tears. “Oh,
if I could continue living with my daughter, how happy I would be!”
Then the witch took the mother's life.
2:6:
Later, a worried man approached the witch.“My entire village suffers 
from a drought... Please make it rain. I'll give my life.”The witch 
granted his wish, and he returned to the village, where it began to 
rain. He shouted with glee as a village girl ran up to him. The girl, 
his childhood friend and betrothed, shared in the joy of the rain.
“Finally, the wedding can be held!”the villagers exclaimed. 
But no one knew it rained in exchange for the man's life.
3:6:
When the witch granted someone's wish, she took their life. Listen to wishes, 
take lives, and so on. However, the witch grew weary of repeating the same 
thing every day. She tired of even humans who blindly accepted their deprived 
lives. But the cruel and fickle witch found a way to erase her boredom: to see 
wishes come true and take away the lives of those who desired to live longer. 
Thus, the witch began to delay the payment of the requester's life.
4:6:
One day, a girl visited the witch and made a request.
“I wish to apologize to my brother...”
The witch listened to the wish, which was disproportionate 
to the girl's life, and she unexpectedly inquired.
“Is that your wish? What a pitiful thing. Go apologize to him.”
“But... I cannot see my brother anymore...”
The girl spoke to the witch amidst her sobs.
5:6:
Not long ago, a girl who had lost her parents lived with her elder brother 
and quarreled with him over the most insignificant things. She eventually 
ran away from home and was attacked by a beast in the forest where she had 
been wandering. The witch was reminded of that story, as she'd once had a 
request from a brother:“Please save my sister.”Her body had been torn 
apart and was on the verge of death, but she had helped the girl.
6:6:
Not even the witch's magic can bring things back from the dead. But 
lives taken in exchange for granting wishes remained as crystals 
imbued with magic. The witch called the brother's soul, which allowed 
him to talk to his sister.“I'm sorry for getting angry over such 
stupid things,”the girl said. The witch simply couldn't understand 
her apologies.“Silly girl, throwing her life away like this. The 
brother who saved her can't even rest in peace.”
7:6:
Afterward, the witch did not take the girl's life and instead began 
living with her. Even if she had taken the despondent girl's life, she 
would not have enjoyed it. Moreover, the fickle witch was interested 
in her, and life with the obedient girl changed the witch's cruel 
nature little by little. The witch even considered no longer taking 
lives to compensate for wishes. Over time, the girl became an 
invaluable person in the witch's life.
8:6:
However, such stories usually end in tragedy. Humans who held grudges 
against those who took others' lives as payment believed the girl to 
be associated with the witch, and they killed the girl when the witch
was not around. The witch became furious upon finding out and used her
magical power to turn into a gigantic monster. The monster went on a
rampage all over the kingdom, eventually reducing it to ashes.
9:6:
After returning to normal, the witch cast a spell on the girl's dead body, 
turning it into a crystal. She vanished into the depths of the forest 
with the crystal, who used to be the most important person to her.
...No one knows what happened to the witch after that. Rumors swell about 
a witch living at the edge of the forest who grants wishes in exchange 
for something. But no one knows whether it is the same witch.
Here ends the witch's tale...
